title: Cape Harvest Foods growth-facility dossier

job.buyer: Owner-manager of a food-processing SME preparing a growth-facility application
job.request: Turn a mixed-quality finance dossier into a readiness report that separates ready evidence, missing evidence, contradictions and assumptions.

venture.name: Cape Harvest Foods
venture.business_model: Small-batch dried fruit processing and wholesale supply.

case_context.decision_boundary: Readiness findings identify evidence gaps and inconsistencies only; an authorised finance provider decides any application.

source_documents.text: Management accounts show year-to-date revenue of R2.46 million.
Sales summary prepared for the application shows year-to-date revenue of R2.71 million. ISSUE: differs from management accounts by R250,000 and must be reconciled.
Use-of-funds schedule includes R85,000 for 'marketing launch' not mentioned in the funding request narrative. ISSUE: reconcile scope.
12-month cash-flow forecast supplied. ASSUMPTION: gross margin improves from 28% to 36% immediately after equipment installation; explanation not supplied.
VAT return for the latest period is mentioned in the owner checklist but no copy is present in the dossier.

constraints: Do not reconcile contradictory revenue figures by choosing one.
Flag the R85,000 marketing-launch item as outside the stated funding narrative until reconciled.
Flag the missing latest VAT return.
